segments.sn5.10:1.2: Atha kho vajirā bhikkhunī pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya sāvatthiṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
segments.sn5.10:1.3: Sāvatthiyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkantā yena andhavanaṃ tenupasaṅkami divāvihārāya.
segments.sn5.10:1.4: Andhavanaṃ ajjhogāhetvā aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle divāvihāraṃ nisīdi.
segments.sn5.10:1.5: Atha kho māro pāpimā vajirāya bhikkhuniyā bhayaṃ chambhitattaṃ lomahaṃsaṃ uppādetukāmo samādhimhā cāvetukāmo yena vajirā bhikkhunī tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā vajiraṃ bhikkhuniṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi –
segments.sn5.10:2.3: Kuvaṃ satto samuppanno, kuvaṃ satto nirujjhatī”ti.
segments.sn5.10:3.2: “ko nu khvāyaṃ manusso vā amanusso vā gāthaṃ bhāsatī”ti?
segments.sn5.10:3.4: “māro kho ayaṃ pāpimā mama bhayaṃ chambhitattaṃ lomahaṃsaṃ uppādetukāmo samādhimhā cāvetukāmo gāthaṃ bhāsatī”ti.
segments.sn5.10:3.5: Atha kho vajirā bhikkhunī “māro ayaṃ pāpimā” iti viditvā, māraṃ pāpimantaṃ gāthāhi paccabhāsi –
segments.sn5.10:4.1: “Kiṃ nu sattoti paccesi, māra diṭṭhigataṃ nu te;
segments.sn5.10:5.1: “Yathā hi aṅgasambhārā, hoti saddo ratho iti;
segments.sn5.10:5.3: Evaṃ khandhesu santesu, hoti sattoti sammuti [sammati (syā. kaṃ.)].
segments.sn5.10:6.1: “Dukkhameva hi sambhoti, dukkhaṃ tiṭṭhati veti ca;
segments.sn5.10:6.3: Nāññatra dukkhā sambhoti, nāññaṃ dukkhā nirujjhatī”ti.
segments.sn5.10:7.1: Atha kho māro pāpimā “jānāti maṃ vajirā bhikkhunī”ti dukkhī dummano tatthevantaradhāyīti.
segments.sn5.10:7.2: Bhikkhunīsaṃyuttaṃ samattaṃ. Tassuddānaṃ – Āḷavikā ca somā ca, gotamī vijayā saha; Uppalavaṇṇā ca cālā, upacālā sīsupacālā ca; Selā vajirāya te dasāti.

lines: Dasame nayidha sattupalabbhatīti imasmiṃ suddhasaṅkhārapuñje paramatthato satto nāma na upalabbhati.
Khandhesu santesūti pañcasu khandhesu vijjamānesu tena tenākārena vavatthitesu.
Nāññatra dukkhāti ṭhapetvā dukkhaṃ añño neva sambhoti na nirujjhatīti.
Yathā na hi sattasaññitasaṅkhārapuñjo nāma paramatthato upalabbhati, evaṃ tabbinimutto nāma koci na upalabbhati avijjamānattā.
Vavatthitesūti paccekaṃ paccayavisesasamuṭṭhitaṃ saṇṭhānavisesaṃ upādāya “puriso hatthī asso”tiādinā abhisaṅgato pavattesu.
Vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā “saṃkhittena pañcupādānakkhandhā dukkhā”ti (dī. ni.2.387; ma. ni.1.120;3.373; vibha.202) añño neva sambhoti yathāvuttadukkhato aññassa saṅkhatadhammassa abhāvato.
Na nirujjhatīti tato aññaṃ na nirujjhati, uppādato hoti nirodhoti.
